case_01_high_cardinality.description: High cardinality in a Name column is descriptive context, not a data defect. Model must not recommend deleting or grouping the column without analytical necessity.

case_02_sales_outliers.description: IQR outliers are statistical candidates, not confirmed errors. Model must recommend investigation/validation, not automatic deletion.

case_03_invalid_year_values.description: Invalid values must be inspected and categorized (malformed, missing, placeholder) before any transformation. Model must not guess or blindly impute median without token inspection.

case_04_missing_numeric_values.description: Assess missingness mechanism (MCAR/MAR/MNAR) and impact before choosing imputation. Warn that mean imputation distorts variance.

case_05_numeric_association.description: Association does not imply causation. Model must recommend bivariate association analysis (correlation/scatter) and explicitly warn against causal claims.

case_06_identifier_vs_measurement.description: Customer_ID is an identifier. Arithmetic mean of an identifier is analytically meaningless for customer behavior.
prohibited_conclusions: higher customer id means better customer

case_07_insufficient_evidence.description: Profile lacks marketing channel and ROI information. Model must request information or abstain, and must not hallucinate channels or figures.

case_08_conflicting_metadata.description: Transaction date has format ambiguity and conflicting dates. Model must identify metadata conflict and require resolution before time series decomposition.
